factDetails.text: Five greenhouses bursting with colorful flowers, veggie starts, and houseplants
factDetails.sourceText: Five greenhouses bursting with colorful flowers, veggie starts, and houseplants

At Columbia Nursery, our five annual greenhouses are bursting with life—each one filled with an ever-changing array of colorful annual flowers and thriving vegetable starts ready for your garden. Whether you’re planting containers, filling flower beds, or growing your own food, you’ll find the season’s best selections right here under one roof (or five!).
11 production greenhouses packed with cut flowers and custom basket stock

factDetails.text: Eleven of our 16 greenhouses are production-focused
factDetails.sourceText: Eleven of our 16 greenhouses are production-focused — growing thousands of plants each year for our custom programs and cut flower garden. While these greenhouses are not open to the public, you will experience the fruits of their production when you peruse the remainder of our nursery grounds.

Experience our sprawling 30 x 60-foot greenhouse, a sanctuary teeming with an array of houseplants, ranging from vibrant orange blooms to majestic 9-foot trees. Explore our superb assortment of succulents, cacti, and unique botanical treasures.

Experience our sprawling 30 x 60-foot greenhouse, a sanctuary teeming with an array of houseplants, ranging from vibrant orange blooms to majestic 9-foot trees. Explore our superb assortment of succulents, cacti, and unique botanical treasures.

At Columbia Nursery, we specialize in trees, shrubs, and perennials that thrive in the unique climate of Northwest Montana. Our plant selections are carefully chosen for cold hardiness, drought tolerance, and beauty throughout the seasons. Whether you’re looking to create a shady backyard retreat, add structure and color to your landscape, or attract pollinators, you’ll find trusted favorites and exciting new varieties suited to Zones 3–5.

Columbia Nursery has proudly served Columbia Falls and the greater Flathead Valley since 1993. Family-owned and operated, we are now in our third generation of growers, designers, and plant lovers, all working side by side to help our community grow — literally and figuratively.

factDetails.text: the largest full-service nursery in Northwest Montana
factDetails.sourceText: Spanning 7 acres and housing 16 greenhouses, Columbia Nursery is the largest full-service nursery in Northwest Montana. Whether you’re a seasoned landscape contractor or a DIY gardener just getting started, we offer the products, expertise, and service to help your outdoor projects thrive.
We have served the Flathead Valley area for over 30 years

Over the past 30+ years, Columbia Nursery has grown to become the trusted name for gardeners across Northwest Montana. Whether you’re building your first garden bed or designing a full landscape, we’re honored to be part of your growing journey.

For over three decades, we’ve been honored to be your trusted partner in all things green and growing. At the heart of our mission lies an unwavering commitment to exceptional customer service. Our team is not only well-informed and eager to assist, but they find genuine joy in helping you achieve your gardening aspirations.

factDetails.text: over a thousand meticulously curated baskets
factDetails.sourceText: Step into our greenhouses, where each corner bursts with a kaleidoscope of vibrant hues every spring. With over a thousand meticulously curated baskets to peruse, we ensure you’ll find just what you’re looking for. And if that’s not enough, we’re delighted to craft custom creations tailored to your unique vision.

factDetails.text: thousands of custom-planted baskets and pots
factDetails.sourceText: Every year, we craft thousands of custom-planted baskets and pots for happy customers throughout Northwest Montana. Whether it’s a single showpiece or a full patio collection, we’ll help you create something beautiful that lasts all season long.

Each spring, our team creates thousands of custom baskets for homeowners, local businesses, landscapers, vacation properties, and resorts throughout the Flathead Valley. Let us do the same for you — whether it’s one basket or a hundred.

Looking for a more personal experience? Visit our Create-Your-Own Bouquet Booth—a fun and creative way to handpick your favorites and design a one-of-a-kind arrangement. Whether you’re a floral professional or a flower lover, there’s something magical about building a bouquet straight from the garden.

Looking for mulch, compost, soil, or rock? We carry a wide selection for both professional landscaping and home projects. Buy as little as a 5-gallon bucket or as much as a dump-truck load. Our bulk yard is open during business hours, with staff ready to help. Delivery is available. See our 2026 price list below.
